name: devhost-monorepo
description: devhost: turn a Mac mini (Apple Silicon or Intel) into a headless Claude Code dev server

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/contract packages/cli && npm run build -w @devhost/app
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/contract packages/cli && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/app --noEmit
scripts.check:gen: npm run gen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contract/src/generated
scripts.check: npm run check:gen && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:rust
